title: Balise — overview
description: v1 is the referential: data quality first (docs/13). The availability panels are 🔌 v2 and read empty until the seam is switched on (docs/06 §A).

panels.title: Referential objects
panels.description: Nav aids + active spots. The v1 product, in one number (docs/00).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM nav_aid WHERE active) + (SELECT count(*) FROM spot WHERE active) AS value

panels.title: Harbours reachable by neither phone nor VHF
panels.description: Must be 0: in v1 the phone *is* the availability feature (docs/13).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM harbour WHERE (phone IS NULL OR phone = '') AND vhf_channel IS NULL

panels.title: Corrections submitted per day (v1's contribution loop)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, category AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM issue WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🔌 Feeds silent > 3 × ttl (v2)
panels.description: A stale feed must degrade to `unknown`, never stay green (docs/06). Reads 0 in v1: the table is empty.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM feed WHERE active AND (last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < now() - make_interval(secs => 3 * ttl_seconds))

panels.title: 🔌 Statuses served as free (v2)
panels.description: Free displayed = confidence ≥ 0.4 and inside its hard-expiry window. Reads 0 in v1: the table is empty.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM spot_status WHERE state = 'free' AND confidence >= 0.4 AND as_of > now() - interval '6 hours'

panels.title: 🔌 Stale free (audit violation) (v2)
panels.description: Must be 0: a free older than its hard expiry may never be shown (docs/13). Reads 0 in v1: the table is empty.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM spot_status WHERE state = 'free' AND confidence >= 0.4 AND as_of < now() - interval '6 hours'
SELECT CAST(value AS bigint) AS value FROM meta WHERE key = 'ref_version'

panels.title: 🔌 Observations per hour by tier (v2)
panels.description: T1 partner feeds vs T2 community vs T3 AIS (docs/06).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS time, source_kind::text AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM observation WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('hour', updated_at) AS time, state::text AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM spot_status WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per-source referential health
panels.description: Counts and last successful sync — the earliest warning of a broken source.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.id AS source, s.last_sync_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM nav_aid n WHERE n.source_id = s.id) AS nav_aids, (SELECT count(*) FROM spot sp WHERE sp.source_id = s.id AND sp.active) AS spots FROM source s ORDER BY s.id

SELECT id, last_seen_at, ttl_seconds, accepted_24h, rejected_24h, round(rejected_24h::numeric / GREATEST(accepted_24h + rejected_24h, 1), 3) AS rejection_rate FROM feed WHERE active ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC NULLS FIRST
